goal_level: L3 station-radius GHSL corrected population tile custody gate
first_wave_rule: Probe the corrected selected GHSL tile URLs; download only rows with current public size at or below 60 MB; reuse retained cached ZIPs; keep all unresolved corrected selected rows as blockers.
cache_policy: Raw GHSL ZIP files are stored under air-monitoring/.cache/station-radius-ghsl-population-tiles/ and are not committed; rerun this script to rehydrate them from public GHSL tile URLs.

evidence_gate_counts.reader_use: The corrected routing gate defines the denominator URL queue used here.
HEAD or range probes provide current file-size custody before download decisions.
Only corrected selected rows with current size <= 60 MB are eligible for this custody pass.
Downloaded ZIP files are hashed and inspected, but raw ZIP bodies stay in the ignored cache.
Hashes make downloaded file custody reproducible without committing raw ZIP bodies.
Opened rasters must match the corrected tile origin before catchments are computed.
Large selected tiles need a separate full-custody pass before catchments are complete.
Blocked selected tiles remain visible as denominator blockers.
No catchment population, PM2.5 exposure, or map is computed here.

tile_custody_rows.reader_use: Use downloaded rows as corrected-queue GHSL population denominator custody evidence; do not use blocked rows for catchment denominators.
tile_custody_rows.blocking_gap: Corrected-queue file custody and corrected-bound inspection are closed for this tile, but catchment radius, de-duplication, station joins, and grade assumptions remain open.
tile_custody_rows.non_claim: This corrected-queue GHSL population tile custody gate probes the corrected tile URLs, reuses or downloads ZIP files, records SHA-256 hashes, and checks opened GeoTIFF bounds against the corrected GHSL tile origin. It does not compute station-radius population, compute PM2.5 exposure, validate same-station joins, freeze radius or de-duplication rules, or promote monitor-grade rows.
